spec: OCP Open Rack v3 Base & HPR Specification

OCP-ORV3-MECH-001.clause: ORv3 §4.1 Rack Width, 21-inch Rail & 48 mm OU Pitch
OCP-ORV3-MECH-001.title: ORv3 机柜外部宽度与 21 英寸 / 48 mm OU 模数
OCP-ORV3-MECH-001.quote: Open Rack v3 outer cabinet width is nominally 600 mm with 21-inch (538 mm) internal equipment bay and 48 mm OpenU (OU) vertical pitch.

OCP-ORV3-MECH-002.clause: ORv3 §4.3 Static Load Rating & Hall Floor Bearing
OCP-ORV3-MECH-002.title: ORv3 整机柜满载质量及机房等效楼板荷载上限
OCP-ORV3-MECH-002.quote: Standard ORv3 supports up to 1600 kg static load; ORv3 HPR supports up to 1800 kg, subject to hall distributed floor-load limit.

OCP-ORV3-MECH-003.title: ORv3 前部维护与后部盲插母排/歧管检修净距
OCP-ORV3-MECH-003.quote: Provide minimum 1.2 m front service aisle for 21-inch tray extraction and 1.2 m rear aisle for busbar/manifold maintenance.

OCP-ORV3-MECH-004.clause: ORv3 §4.6 Overhead Busway & Manifold Tie-In Clearance
OCP-ORV3-MECH-004.title: ORv3 顶部母线插接与液冷总管检修净空
OCP-ORV3-MECH-004.quote: Maintain at least 0.6 m overhead clearance above the rack top plane for busway whips, blind-mate headers and optical trays.
